localFacts.fact: Canon España lists the EOS R50 (black) at approx. 328 g body only and 375 g with card and battery (CIPA).
Iberia allows one cabin bag up to 10 kg with max. 56 x 40 x 25 cm; all four full-size picks (42,5 / 39,4 / 40 / 39 cm folded) fit by length.
Sagrada Família normativa: photos or videos with a tripod are not allowed inside the site, except for people or companies accredited beforehand.
Alhambra (Patronato): photos only without flash and without tripod, monopod or any other camera stabilising element.
Spanish terms: rótula de bola, columna central, zapata / placa de liberación rápida; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: A tripod is light and stable only while the centre column stays down.
localPainPoints.fix: Rank on column-down height (English post); Element MII 132 cm, Peak Design 130 cm.

quotes.text: Es un trípode ligero pero muy estable si no despliegas la columna central, para transportarlo es una gozada.

localPainPoints.pain: A cheap light aluminium tripod soon feels unstable.
localPainPoints.fix: Pick legs, not load rating: the K&F is the budget pick but keep its column low; the Element MII adds a bag hook.

quotes.text: Empecé con un trípode de aluminio (cullman), que, la verdad, se me quedó corto en seguida: barato, ligero, pero nada estable

localPainPoints.pain: Hiking and stability pull in opposite directions.
localPainPoints.fix: Peak Design for hiking/cabin bag, Element MII for home and local landscapes (English decision list).

quotes.text: para senderismo uno ligero y que pliegue mucho, para astrofotografía mejor uno muy estable y robusto.
